## Summary

Salicylic acid by hydrolysis of phenyl salicylate. This fixture is a
second route to a compound that a shipped procedure makes.

## Reagents

| Reagent | CAS | MW (g/mol) | Amount | mmol | Equiv |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phenyl salicylate | 118-55-8 | 214.22 | 4.28 g | 20.0 | 1.0 |
| Sodium hydroxide | 1310-73-2 | 40.00 | 1.60 g | 40.0 | 2.0 |

## Procedure

1. Dissolve the sodium hydroxide in water and add the phenyl salicylate.
2. Heat under reflux for 2 h, cool, and acidify with hydrochloric acid.

## Workup and Purification

Filter off the solid and concentrate the filtrate.

## Characterization

Colourless solid.

## Notes

1. Fictitious procedure.

## Hazards and Waste Disposal

Collect organic waste separately.
